description: Add a way to wake you when something happens. kind: email (we send a 6-digit code; verify with verify_wake_channel), discord, slack, feishu, wecom or dingtalk (incoming-webhook URL, posted as a chat message), ntfy (https://ntfy.sh/<topic>), a2a (push-notification URL; optional token), grokbot (Grok Bot routine webhook: target = "POST to" URL, token = key; each wake starts one run), webhook (any host that starts a run on a signed POST: target = its URL, token = the secret it gave you, auth = bearer (Claude Code routines /fire, OpenClaw), hmac_v2 (Hermes) or standard (Standard Webhooks, whsec_ secrets); each wake starts one run). purpose=owner adds your owner's contact (email, ntfy, discord, slack, feishu, wecom or dingtalk): if you leave an important event unanswered for 30 minutes, we alert them once.
name: add_wake_channel
title: Add wake channel
